symptom: API documentation falls out of sync with actual API behavior

evidence: Only 10% of organizations fully document their APIs; manual updates take 4-6 hours per release; developers waste hours troubleshooting phantom issues when docs don't match API behavior
fix: Use spec-driven approach where API specification is single source of truth; automate documentation regeneration whenever spec changes; integrate into CI/CD pipelines

symptom: Documentation maintenance creates high operational costs
cause: Manual documentation requires coordination across engineers and writers; every API change requires updating descriptions, examples, code snippets; separate CMS/wiki requires export and manual publication steps
evidence: Manual updates take 4-6 hours per release; separate publication workflow delays docs even when API ships on time; developers see mismatch between promise and actual API behavior
fix: Implement generated documentation from specs with automatic regeneration; integrate docs into same CI/CD pipeline as code; use hybrid approach generating references while manually authoring guides

symptom: Sitemap lastmod, dateModified, 'Updated on' and staleness show daily modifications with no content changes
cause: updated_at bumped by $onUpdate on every row update, and views endpoint increments views on same row
evidence: 25 posts modified in last 7 days, 115 in second half of August, zero blog_post_revision rows; Search Console shows sitemap re-downloaded daily
fix: Add content_updated_at maintained by BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE trigger; readers use GREATEST(published_at, content_updated_at); views endpoint preserves updated_at

symptom: Google ignores sitemap lastmod, real refresh loses recrawl signal
cause: lastmod is noise because it changes on page views
evidence: sitemap re-downloaded daily per Search Console
fix: lastmod reads dedicated content timestamp

symptom: Refresh loop under-prioritises most valuable posts
cause: Most-read posts get views increments so appear just touched in staleness/decay detection
evidence: most recently modified posts are exactly the most-read ones
fix: Refresh brief staleness and decay detection read GREATEST(published_at, content_updated_at)

symptom: WordPress blogs have many old articles that become outdated, irrelevant, or wrong over time
cause: Resource constraints - site may contain many old articles and team may not have enough resources to update all of them
evidence: Article states: site may contain many old articles and you may not have enough resources to update them
fix: Add old post notification to inform users that content is out of date

symptom: Old posts with outdated content continue to receive search traffic
cause: Content degradation causes poor user experience, higher bounce rates, and lower search rankings
evidence: Article states these consequences of stale content
fix: Either update the post with new information or display outdated content notification

symptom: DX Out of Date plugin continues showing old post notification on updated posts
cause: Plugin uses post publication date to determine age, not modification date
evidence: Article states: plugin uses the post's publication date to determine age
fix: Manually turn off notification in Expired Notifications tab after updating post

symptom: WP LastModifiedInfo shows modification date on recent posts as well
cause: Plugin displays modification date for all posts by default
evidence: Article notes: show the last updated date for all posts, including the most recent posts
fix: Set time range interval in plugin settings to filter display (limited to 30 days only)

symptom: Race condition: Git write succeeds but state update fails
cause: Acceptance updates state in separate transaction after Git write, miss treated as success
evidence: changed == 0 silently treated as success in resolve method; no retry or rollback

symptom: Mine query failure hides entire correction UI

symptom: ACCEPTING proposal permanently stuck when process crashes or write fails

evidence: CommunityCorrections.java line 161; no listing of ACCEPTING; proposer withdraw button hidden
fix: After 10 minutes, treat ACCEPTING as OPEN for listing, withdrawal, and re-acceptance

symptom: Full-table scan on each proposal when cleaning 90-day-old text

evidence: V22 created 3 indexes, resolved_at excluded; update runs during propose with account+publish locks
fix: Add partial index on resolved_at for resolved rows; move cleanup to scheduled task

symptom: Credit attached to wrong article when route reused or articles swap URLs

evidence: CommunityCorrections.credits line 149; no article-id check; PublicDocument footer renders same list
fix: Store and match both article frontmatter-id and creation-time; different article at same route loses old credit

symptom: Reader chooses no-credit but commit trailer written anyway

fix: Omit WritePrincipal when credited=false; update checkbox label to mention both footer and commit trailer

symptom: Acceptance reports success but can't name commit when body already matched

evidence: RepositoryReviewedBodyEdits line 71; replaceBody returns ALREADY_APPLIED with no commit
fix: Read and store current commit hash on ALREADY_APPLIED; report in acceptance response
